text.card: A red giant 2,183 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.85 solar masses and 7.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,672 K at its surface.
